electrical_domains.name: protective_earth
electrical_domains.rule: Bond cabinet, machine frame, spindle chassis, cable armor, and DIN rail to PE.

electrical_domains.name: 36v_motion
electrical_domains.rule: The documented S-360-36 supply is 36 V / 10 A, with simultaneous-load capacity unqualified. Feed each CL57T P4 +VDC/GND through its own polarity-verified fused star branch; never feed Octopus MAIN POWER.

electrical_domains.name: 24v_control
electrical_domains.rule: A separate regulated 24 V supply feeds Octopus MAIN POWER, contactors, relays, and field I/O.

electrical_domains.name: 5v_motion_logic
electrical_domains.rule: A protected 5 V supply feeds CL57T P1 PUL/DIR optocoupler anodes through the qualified common-anode interface; its 0 V is controller logic return. S3=5V. ENA remains unconnected.

electrical_domains.name: drive_encoder_supply
electrical_domains.rule: Each CL57T P2 VCC/EGND supplies only its matched encoder. Do not inject external power or bond encoder returns to other drives or logic. Internal isolation is not established by the available manual.

electrical_domains.name: 5v_home_isolated
electrical_domains.rule: A separate current-limited isolated 5 V field supply feeds the traced stock limit circuit through four energized-healthy optocoupler channels; no stock 5 V reaches a STOP GPIO.

electrical_domains.name: 5v_probe_isolated
electrical_domains.rule: Probe and toolsetter use a current-limited isolated 5 V field supply. The provisional HW-399 uses IN1/OUT1 and IN2/OUT2; field GND and logic HGND must never be joined.

electrical_domains.name: spindle_analog_isolated
electrical_domains.rule: Planned isolated 0-5 V spindle command and analog common remain HOLD: installed servo identity, harness continuity, analog gain, and measured RPM are not qualified. Generic T3A/T3L 0-10 V full scale must not be assumed to match 0-5 V.

electrical_domains.name: spindle_digital_isolated
electrical_domains.rule: The final RS-485 command path uses galvanic isolation and break-before-make selection from the retained analog fallback; both command paths may never be active together.

electrical_domains.name: logic
electrical_domains.rule: Octopus GPIO never receives 5 V or 24 V field wiring directly.
